items.title: The quest for the truth behind Australian nurses' massacre in WWII
items.description: A relative of one of the 21 Australian nurses massacred by Japanese soldiers on a remote Indonesian beach in WWII wants the real story of what happened to be told.

items.title: More missiles and ditch the UN: What One Nation’s foreign policy looks like
items.description: With One Nation running red hot in the polls and posing a serious challenge to the incumbent parties, there's more scrutiny on what its foreign policy would mean for Australia.

items.title: War helped 're-enliven' Iran's regime. Trump's truce may complicate that
items.description: For decades the Islamic republic has been using its "main enemy" America to distract from its repressive regime, analysts say. But the recent truce with Donald Trump could change that.

items.title: Police speech stuns descendants gathered at site of outback mass killing
items.description: Ronnie's great-grandfather collected bones and teeth from an outback creek bed. Now police say they're 'not proud' of what occurred.

items.title: Pitched as an outback oasis, this remote town is 'actually reinventing itself'
items.description: A decade after the last coal truck rumbled out of Leigh Creek, Baljit Singh Bajwa put millions of dollars on the line to invest in the shrinking mining town.

items.title: On health and child care, Labor might have found Pauline Hanson's kryptonite
items.description: Pauline Hanson said thousands of words in her marathon appearance at the National Press Club, but only a few of them will be heard widely.

items.title: Scott Miller thinks Australia probably hates him. He's desperate to reverse the damage
items.description: From Olympic silver medallist to convicted drug supplier, Scott Miller opens up on one of the biggest downfalls in the history of Australian sport and the moments that saved his life as he seeks redemption.

items.title: Live: Germany finds last-gasp winner against Côte d'Ivoire, Netherlands thump Sweden
items.description: Deniz Undav comes off the bench to score twice as Germany claims a late win over Côte d'Ivoire after the Netherlands beat Sweden 5-1. Follow live.

items.title: Iran closes Strait of Hormuz but US says traffic is flowing
items.description: Iran says it has closed the Strait of Hormuz over Israel's continued attacks in Lebanon, which killed at least 16 people on Saturday, local time.

items.title: Fuel price cuts extended through July, but discount drops by half
items.description: The federal government is winding back its discount to the fuel excise over the next month as the 32 cents per litre fuel discount will drop to 16 cents.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
